Perfect! The fix is working. Here's what I changed:

1. **Changed `r"[^a-z0-9]"` to `r"[^a-z0-9]+"`** — The `+` quantifier matches one or more consecutive non-alphanumerics, collapsing runs of special characters and spaces into a single dash instead of replacing each character individually.

2. **Added `.strip("-")`** — This removes any leading or trailing dashes that may result from punctuation at the start or end of the text.

Now `slugify('Hello,  World!')` correctly returns `'hello-world'` instead of `'hello---world-'`. Both test cases pass.
